svg.title: Polymer degradation routes
svg.desc: Four panels: random chain scission, depolymerisation or unzipping to monomer, thermal oxidation as a radical cycle, and photo-oxidation initiated by ultraviolet light.
svg.text: M falls fast, no monomer released
chain end radical releases monomer one by one
e.g. PMMA → MMA (≈ 100 %), PS → styrene, PTFE → TFE
result: chain scission, yellowing, chalking, cracks
needs UV absorbers / HALS (not just antioxidants)
